audience: online stores that track seller and product reviews in Shopper Approved

useCases.title: Review seller reviews
useCases.text: List the seller reviews of the store with rating, date, reviewer name and comment. Open one review by its order ID.

useCases.title: Track the average seller rating
useCases.text: Read the total number of seller reviews and their average rating for the store.

useCases.title: Compare product ratings
useCases.text: Read the review count and rating of each product, or of one product, and the reviews of that product.

useCases.title: Read product reviews by date
useCases.text: List the product reviews for the whole store within a date range.
